name: runode
description: Drive the terminals of the running runode app

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the sessions and the window layout as JSON

subcommands.name: read
subcommands.description: Print the text on a session's screen

options.name: --lines
options.description: Print N lines from the bottom, scrollback included

options.name: --command
options.description: Print the output of the Nth last command (needs shell integration)

subcommands.name: send
subcommands.description: Type text or press keys in a session

options.name: --paste
options.description: Paste the text instead of typing it

options.name: --key
options.description: Press KEY after the text; 'down*3' presses it three times

options.name: --enter
options.description: Press Enter at the end

options.name: --wait
options.description: Wait for the agent, the command or a quiet screen afterwards

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Give up waiting after SECS seconds

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a session's agent or screen reaches a state

options.name: --for
options.description: What to wait for (default: stopped)

suggestions.name: stopped
suggestions.description: The agent is not working: idle, asking you, or no agent

suggestions.name: command
suggestions.description: The next command at the shell prompt finished

suggestions.name: text
suggestions.description: A line on the screen matches REGEX

suggestions.name: quiet
suggestions.description: The screen did not change for SECS

options.name: --lines
options.description: With --for text: look only at the last N lines

options.name: --new
options.description: With --for text: skip the lines already there

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Give up after SECS seconds

subcommands.name: open
subcommands.description: Open a terminal in the app and print its session id

options.name: --tab
options.description: Open a new tab after the session's (default)

options.name: --right
options.description: Split the session's pane to the right

options.name: --down
options.description: Split the session's pane downwards

options.name: --near
options.description: Open next to SESSION instead of your own

options.name: --cwd
options.description: Start the shell in DIR

options.name: --focus
options.description: Switch the app to the new terminal

subcommands.name: kill
subcommands.description: End a session and close its pane

subcommands.name: focus
subcommands.description: Show a session's pane and bring its window to the front

subcommands.name: setup
subcommands.description: Teach an agent to use runode

suggestions.name: usage
suggestions.description: Show the model, context and cost of Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and pi under their pane

options.name: --print
options.description: Show the instructions instead of installing them

subcommands.name: usage-hook
subcommands.description: What the agents run to report their usage

subcommands.name: pair
subcommands.description: Pair a phone: shows a QR code and waits for the phone

options.name: --addr
options.description: Also offer ADDR, say 127.0.0.1 for a simulator on this Mac

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the devices as JSON

name: -h
--help
options.description: Show the help

name: -V
--version
options.description: Show the version

options.name: --host
options.description: Run as the terminal host in its own process (the app starts it)

options.name: --take-over
options.description: With --host: take over the sessions of the running host after an upgrade
